function.name: system_tray_call
function.description: This function handles different system tray calls based on the message received. It can notify icon, cleanup icons, initialize, insert, clear, or remove dock in the system tray.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The system message to be processed

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the message processing. It can be 0, -1 or the result of a specific function call depending on the message.
